description: Versioned benchmark dataset manifest. Every scored property of the benchmark that must not drift between runs is pinned here: the fixture set (sites.json), the scoring contract (rubric.json), the capture viewport and the exploration budgets. Change any of these and you MUST bump `version` and re-seed fixtures/benchmark/baseline.json.

baseline.policy: Scores from an accepted run are stored per site. A later run flags (and fails on) a per-site drop larger than rubric.regressionTolerance. Improvements are reported but never written back automatically — re-seeding the baseline is a deliberate act (delete baseline.json, rerun, commit the new file together with the rubric/fixture version bump that justified it).

capture.fidelityPage: page-001 (the site entry route, captured pristine before interaction exploration)

environment.engine: package.json version recorded per run into the report (engineVersion)
environment.runtime: node version + platform recorded per run into the report
environment.network: zero external network — every site is a local fixture server; live-site testing is a separate, manual contract and never part of this benchmark
